scope: mathematical moduli-route target selection when the QoI is pointwise/support-level and candidate loci may be singular or nonreduced
lesson: Before treating tangent surjectivity or obstruction vanishing as the success condition, type the locus as support/reduction, smooth reduced local scheme, full scheme, or formal/higher-Artin object and verify that the registered QoI actually requires that structure.
non_guarantees: does not prove dominance of any witness space
does not make reduced geometry sufficient for scheme-theoretic deformation questions
does not generalize from Hodge loci without a fresh applicability witness
validation_needed_before_reuse: fresh cross-problem transfer with a target-level mismatch falsifier
